# Armin Bayati, PhD

> Cellular and molecular biologist. Senior Scientist III in Neuroimmunology at Merck (2026-present) and Fellow in AI/ML Training for Cell Biology and Neuroscience at Aligned Labs (2026-present). Previously Research Fellow at Harvard Medical School and Mass General Brigham, Research Associate at the Montreal Neurological Institute, PhD in Neuroscience from McGill University. 25+ peer-reviewed publications, 1,300+ citations.

This site is a research portfolio: human iPSC disease models, drug discovery, multi-omics, imaging, and machine learning for biology. Pages are static HTML.

## Overview
- [Home](index.html): background, experience timeline, research highlights, news
- [AI/ML Evaluation & Training](ai-ml.html): model evaluation work at Aligned Labs, grading rubrics, common model failure modes in biology, applied ML
- [Publications](publications.html): peer-reviewed papers and preprints
- [Contact](contact.html)
